summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the methodology for performing Sheva Berachot using a single cup, as practiced in Aleppo. He also examines the community practice of reciting all seven berachot even when not in the home of the chatan and kallah, citing the customs of various Hachamim.
questions: How is the one-cup method for Sheva Berachot performed?
Do we recite all seven berachot if the meal is not in the home of the chatan and kallah?
What was the practice in Damascus regarding Sheva Berachot?
Who are some of the Hachamim who supported reciting all seven berachot outside the home of the chatan and kallah?
